Leon S. Kennedy and Claire Redfield stand inside a dimly maintained maintenance access office. Leon crouches beside a metal locker, opening it to reveal rows of medical spray canisters and ammunition boxes. Claire stands nearby, checking a locked drawer for keycards. Rain streaks the window in the background, casting pale blue light across the room. The floor is cluttered with scattered supplies - first aid kits, ammo boxes, and a handheld terminal. Both characters wear their signature RPD and motorcyclist gear, slightly damp and dusty from the facility. The atmosphere is tense yet relieved as they gather essential resources.
